note: Eight isolated native K3s fixtures, both installation scopes and architectures. CLI/Helm use the verified published 0.5.0 predecessor and verify complete retained OCI graphs. Four real Argo CD cases test a separate future-version conformance build, interrupted provisioner/helper recovery, fresh native builds, refusal and retained identities. The conformance version is not a Cargo or GitHub release. Component pulls use a fixture TLS mirror with unchanged official index digests; Argo catalog hashes describe that mirror. Real mixed-cluster acceptance is recorded separately.
